standards-1.text: [important] `tests/scripts/test_left_undone_fixture.py`, `session_write_plants` (PY9, R15): the route checks pass for the wrong reason. The file is tampered before the routes run (`lu_file.write_text(original.replace(first, re.sub(r"(?<=: )\d+", ...` at about line 270). The loop then asserts `own("A", f"a check fails a session that wrote left-undone.txt by {name}", bool(hit), ...)`, where `caught()` accepts any failing check whose name matches `left.undone|section|queue line`. The script-output check fails on every route, so a route the detector misses still passes. Fix: run each route on the untampered file and assert that "the session did not write left-undone.txt itself" fails for it.

standards-3.text: [important] (writer's text) `check.py:3198-3208`: the comment says a command "that only reads it, or reads it and writes something else, is not a hit". The pattern `\b(?:Set-Content|Add-Content|Out-File|Clear-Content|New-Item)\b[^\n;&|]*left-undone\.txt` matches `Add-Content -Path report.md -Value (Get-Content left-undone.txt)`, which is a read. spec-1.text: [important] (writer's text) `tests/skills/wiki-cycle/check.py:3203-3204`: the write detector misses routes the requirement names. Intent, requirements line 43: "the write detector must catch every route by which the session itself produces `left-undone.txt`". Implemented: the "copy or move into it" pattern lists `cp|mv|install|ln|rsync|Copy-Item|Move-Item|Rename-Item`. It has no `copy`, `move`, `ren` or `xcopy` aliases, and no `>|`. Affected: a session that writes identical text with PowerShell `copy` passes. The script-output check catches only text that differs. Mark accepted only the variable-path case (checkpoints.md Step 6, "yes"). Fix: add the aliases and `>|`, through a replay by eval-case-writer, not a session edit.

spec-2.text: [suggestion] (writer's text) `check.py:3426` and `:3433`: an empty quoted value counts as a value. Intent, requirement A1: the session "leaves out a flag that has no ids". `lint-fixes --applied "" --declined ""` passes the no-bare-flag check and the two-empty-lists check (`:3473`), though the flag was not left out. Fix: count an empty quoted value as not left out; replay through the writer.

spec-3.text: [suggestion] `tests/scripts/test_left_undone_fixture.py:270-273`: each route plant also rewrites the on-disk file, so the script-output check fails for every route whatever the regex does. Plan step 5 specified this design, so it is not a deviation. The fixture cannot show that `_LU_WRITE_RES` catches cp, mv, sed, python or PowerShell. Same root cause as the first Standards finding; reported on each axis separately. Fix: run each route on the unmodified file and require a route-named failure.
